description: Maintainer-edited claim declarations. Artifact content, not filenames, is the evidence gate.

claims.title: LoCoMo BM25S exact-evidence baseline
claims.scope: LoCoMo; 1,977 eligible exact canonical evidence-ID questions; one BM25S index per conversation
claim_boundary: Retrieval evidence-ID recall only; not answer accuracy, dense retrieval, graph benefit, reranker benefit, or provider cost.

claims.title: Speaker-prefix sparse representation across split seeds
claims.scope: LoCoMo; five reused conversation-split seeds; held-out exact evidence IDs
claim_boundary: Descriptive split robustness on ten reused conversations; not five independent datasets, answer accuracy, SOTA, or prompt-source substitution.

claims.title: Repeated paired sparse latency comparison
claims.scope: LoCoMo question-only repeated paired raw versus speaker-prefix timing; wall-clock decision channel
claim_boundary: Timing comparison only; quality was not evaluated and quantized timer observations are not an architecture gate.

claims.title: Speaker-aware sparse router
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out split; raw, unconditional speaker-prefix, routed, and two-field RRF sparse arms
claim_boundary: Rejects promotion on this measured split only; post-hoc exploratory result and not a claim about unseen datasets.

claims.title: LongMemEval local session retrieval receipt
claims.scope: Local longmemeval_s.json admission audit; oracle-context subset with no distractor retrieval corpus
claim_boundary: This is a retained failed receipt, not a retrieval score; the prior near-perfect report is invalidated.

claims.title: Native 4096-dimensional FAISS HNSW mechanics
claims.scope: Synthetic normalized 4096-dimensional vectors; FAISS HNSW versus exact Flat; top-10 recall
claim_boundary: Synthetic ANN mechanics and resource evidence only; not semantic or exact source-evidence quality.

claims.title: Native 4096-dimensional FAISS HNSW threshold sweep
claims.scope: Synthetic normalized 4096-dimensional vectors; attested HNSW efSearch threshold sweep
claim_boundary: Synthetic threshold mechanics only; does not justify a production default or semantic quality claim.

claims.title: Turbovec native 4096-dimensional compression frontier
claims.scope: Synthetic normalized 4096-dimensional vectors across five seeds; two-bit and four-bit Turbovec search
claim_boundary: Compression and synthetic ANN mechanics are measured; tested recall loss blocks promotion and this is not conversational evidence or a latency win.

claims.title: 4096-dimensional embedding storage deduplication
claims.scope: Synthetic 512-node SQLite storage comparison with native float32 4096-dimensional vectors
claim_boundary: Storage-layout measurement only; does not establish retrieval quality, scale feasibility, or prompt/KV-cache reduction.

claims.title: MiniLM fixed-pool Recall@10 effect
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out split; 991 exact-evidence questions; MiniLM reranking of fixed 25-item speaker-prefixed BM25S pools
claim_boundary: Selection-only mechanism result on one ten-conversation corpus; candidate-pool oracle remains the ceiling and this is not answer accuracy or a BGE-reranker result.

claims.title: Unconditional MiniLM reranking default
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out multi-hop slice; fixed speaker-prefixed BM25S candidate pools
claim_boundary: Rejects unconditional promotion because the measured multi-hop slice regresses; a gated or differently trained reranker remains open.

claims.title: Associative graph signal beyond node degree
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out split; corpus/query-only PPR versus degree-preserving term-turn sham at equal candidate budget
claim_boundary: Rejects a degree/popularity-only explanation for this lightweight graph; it is not a HippoRAG reproduction or evidence that graph beats BM25S.

claims.title: Associative PPR as a general retrieval default
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out split; associative PPR versus speaker-prefixed BM25S at equal top-25 pools/final top-10
claim_boundary: Not promoted because the clustered interval crosses zero and held-out multi-hop lift is zero; temporal-category follow-up remains open.

claims.title: BGE-M3 learned sparse as a LoCoMo default
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out split; 1,136 exact-evidence questions; equal top-25 learned-sparse versus speaker-prefixed BM25S pools
claim_boundary: Rejects this BGE-M3 sparse configuration on this corpus; does not reject SPLADE++, other learned-sparse models, or other datasets. The 1024-d dense output was excluded.

claims.title: BGE-M3 MaxSim fixed-pool selection
claims.scope: LoCoMo held-out split; MaxSim reranking of fixed speaker-prefixed BM25S top-25 pools
claim_boundary: Positive selection-mechanism result on one corpus; not a ColBERTv2/PLAID reproduction and not promoted because token storage, encoding cost, and independent replication remain open.

claims.title: Late interaction as a production default
claims.scope: Compressed/pruned token-vector retrieval or selection with independent validation and production resource accounting
claim_boundary: Open; positive MaxSim ranking lift does not establish an independent ColBERT candidate channel or an acceptable production resource frontier.

claims.title: Episodic, semantic, and temporal memory-model factorial
claims.scope: Raw episodic sources crossed with provenance-linked facts/summaries and interval/supersession policy
claim_boundary: Open; implementation scaffolds and synthetic temporal invariants are not held-out memory-model evidence.

claims.title: Grounded answer generation from retrieved evidence
claims.scope: Closed-book, retrieved, oracle-evidence, and full-context reader comparison under a priced approved plan
claim_boundary: Open; retrieval recall is not answer quality and no live reader call has been made in this program.

claims.title: External backend architecture Pareto challenge
claims.scope: Vespa, Lucene/Tantivy, DiskANN-family, Qdrant, Milvus, LanceDB, and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch on one immutable workload
claim_boundary: Open; literature mechanisms and repository adapters are not local comparative results.
